title: My Journey
lede: Research, education, and international collaboration have shaped my professional journey.
paragraphs: Holding a Ph.D. in International Relations, I have dedicated my career to understanding the complexities of global politics, conflict, and social change. This commitment was recognized with the Best Doctoral Dissertation Award in International Relations, reflecting my passion for rigorous and impactful research.

Over the years, I have combined academic research with practical experience gained through international projects, humanitarian initiatives, policy research, and multicultural collaboration across Europe, the Middle East, and the United States. These experiences have strengthened my ability to work in diverse environments, build meaningful partnerships, and approach complex challenges from both analytical and practical perspectives.

Beyond my professional career, I believe that learning extends far beyond classrooms and offices. Living, volunteering, and working in different countries has taught me the value of cultural exchange, adaptability, and lifelong learning. Every new place, every project, and every community has broadened my perspective and reinforced my belief that meaningful solutions emerge when academic knowledge is combined with real-world experience.

My interests include international relations, democracy, human rights, migration, civil society, sustainability, environmental issues, and international trade. I am particularly passionate about connecting research with practice and contributing to projects that create meaningful and lasting social impact.
Whether through research, education, consulting, or international collaboration, my goal is to help build a more informed, inclusive, and sustainable future.
